item.title: CEO of Health Care Software Company Sentenced for $1B Fraud Conspiracy
item.description:
📝 The Criminal Division will continue dedicating substantial resources to the fight against telemedicine and medical equipment frauds that drain our health care benefit programs. Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Inspector General (HHS-OIG). The DME suppliers and pharmacies that paid illegal kickbacks in exchange for these doctors’ orders billed Medicare and other insurers more than $1 billion, and Medicare and the insurers paid more than $360 million based on these claims.
🔗 Read more: https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/ceo-health-care-software-company-sentenced-1b-fraud-conspiracy
